desc:
💥 Welcome to Snipers! 💥


What is Snipers? Snipers is a third/first person shooter (fps) arcade fighting game, you spawn with a sniper and fight other people to the death! Sniper Fight, Get To The Top Of Leaderboard, Buy More Guns, No Scope People, roleplay, or explore the city of Snipers.

*Rejoin after buying a gamepass*

Have fun, and thank you for playing! If you enjoyed this game, don't forget to 👍 Like, ⭐ Favorite, and 🔔 Follow!
